character.morphology: Catalog record 11, generation1, familyBits0. Soft amorphous mound with protruding left face and separated bubbles. No legs or biped/quadruped gait.
character.locomotion: Whole body squashes, extends and tilts with detached bubbles. Preserve extreme flat62 and vertical09/63; no invented walking legs.
character.faceAndExpression: Left protruding face and pale/colored face regions expand12/24 and compress10/23/26; swept upper surface14/59 remains over body. Preserve occlusion rather than always drawing front eyes.
character.appendages: Bubbles are detached but part of frame art with source-dependent count/offset. Do not add unrelated sparkles, arms, feet or tail.
character.restraint: Main027..043: gold wrap around lower/main soft body; independent bubbles remain free. Flattened bodies retain restraint.
character.specialStates: Main044 red,047/048 black,061 stone,064 white; derive only when exact source alpha/palette relation is proved.
character.contactAndOrigin: Fixed NCER origin [24, 37] in64px; native scale1. Never center/fit each frame. Preserve Main/Sub aliases and translations, all53 raw sequences/ticks/loop/stop.
